avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce minor cytochrome P450 pathways and potentially reduce cetirizine efficacy; theoretical interaction
avoid_supplements.action: Consider alternative herbal supplements; monitor antihistamine effectiveness if concurrent use unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate CNS depression and sedation when combined with cetirizine's mild sedative effects
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient of additive drowsiness risk; caution with driving or hazardous activities

caution_supplements.name: Kava kava
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive CNS depressant effects with cetirizine
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation; counsel on avoiding concurrent use if possible

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol may potentiate CNS depression and sedation; additive effect with cetirizine's mild sedative properties
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol consumption; counsel on impaired cognition and coordination risk

monitoring_notes: Cetirizine undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism with primary renal elimination, resulting in few clinically significant interactions. Monitor for excessive sedation or CNS depression when combined with other CNS depressants or sedating supplements.
